# Design point P003

## Description

An orchestrator fans out pushed packfiles and reference transactions, coordinating repository instances before accepting the write. Clients keep fetched remote references in a hidden namespace for maintenance, while large-repository acquisition does not use GVFS integrated into standard Git; these choices can coexist but leave demand-driven acquisition outside the standard client.
